title: FB-022 harden destructive path boundary cleanup
summary: Fix FR-017, FR-019, FR-020, FR-021, and related FR-047 validation coverage by proving copy and cleanup targets are inside their intended path roots before filesystem mutation and by wiring the guard test into active reliability checks.
reason: Worker findings showed copy destination setup, probe cache cleanup, startup temp cleanup, and empty scratch container cleanup relied on derived/configured paths before independently proving the allowed mutation boundary. The related path-boundary unit check also resolved the repo root incorrectly and was not run by the active reliability gate.
behavior_before: Some PowerShell copy and cleanup helpers could create or recursively delete under a misconfigured root before a root-specific boundary proof, and the path-boundary unit check was not part of the active reliability wrapper.
behavior_after: Copy and cleanup helpers fail closed unless the mutation target is inside the configured root, has no reparse components in the existing chain, and is not the root itself. The active reliability wrapper now runs the path-boundary guard check.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-PathBoundaryGuardChecks.ps1 assertions for untrusted copy destinations, probe cache root containment, startup temp cleanup containment, and empty scratch container containment
manual_validation: Bundled PowerShell 7: Invoke-PathBoundaryGuardChecks.ps1, Invoke-PendingPublishSafetyChecks.ps1, Invoke-PendingPublishOwnershipChecks.ps1, Invoke-ToolIntegrationChecks.ps1, and Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 passed.
Bundled PowerShell 7: ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 passed and included the path boundary guard check.
rollback_plan: Revert the path-boundary checks, focused unit assertions, and reliability wrapper inclusion, then rerun path-boundary and affected PowerShell validation.
notes: Packet created before code edits. This batch touches high-risk source/scratch/output cleanup boundaries and therefore uses conservative fail-closed guards plus focused temporary-directory tests. FR-047 was completed in the same packet because its broken unit harness and missing active reliability wrapper coverage directly blocked validation for FB-022.
